title: Ashfall: Scanner and Faction Ops
summary: Turn scanner rows, HoloMap markers, faction contact, drone warnings, and cache rewards into one clear field plan.

blocks.title: Scan Before Committing
blocks.body: The scanner should name what you found, why it matters, what mission or marker it belongs to, and whether the route is safe now. Treat every scan as a planning note, not a command to sprint forward.

blocks.title: Portable Field Read
blocks.body: Use the portable scanner from shelter first. Confirm the HoloMap marker, compare risk labels, then decide whether the route needs water, filters, armor, or a shorter return line.
blocks.label: Craft Portable Scanner
blocks.subtitle: Scanner objective

blocks.title: Faction Contact
blocks.body: Crashbreak and Radwarden signals start as recognition and optional work. Read standing, reward reason, and route risk before treating a contact like a combat objective.

blocks.title: Cache Rewards
blocks.body: A good cache tells you why the reward matters: survival buffer, repair part, scanner clue, faction proof, or late-game intel. If you cannot carry it safely, mark it and come back.
